answer: A bond is refunded only after 34 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The umber counter is kept in horizon and ocean shows each reset. An attacker therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 34 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 846 identities would post 4535 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
